manual_review_caveat: Automated checks inspect support decisions, literal substring presence, physical-page coverage, and exact quote/citation resolution. They are smoke checks, not an accuracy score, proof of entailment, or independent factual grounding. The same local model generates and reviews wording. Manually inspect every generated summary, answer, selected passage, and grounding-review output. This small synthetic set is not an untouched holdout and says nothing about arbitrary contracts or research papers.
scope: Real local model generation and review against two public synthetic PDFs.

manifest.scope: Small synthetic smoke regression, not an accuracy benchmark or untouched holdout.
manifest.checking: required_terms and forbidden_terms use substring checks against lowercased answer text. These checks are lexical smoke checks only; manually review every claim and cited passage. Equivalent wording can fail lexical checks.
manifest.provenance: required_pages are 1-based physical PDF pages, not printed section labels. A source must resolve to an exact passage on the cited page of the selected original PDF.
